lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਤ ਡਰੈ ਜਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so kat darai j khasam samhaarai ||
lines.translation: One who contemplates his Lord and Master - why should he be afraid?

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਰਿ ਡਰਿ ਪਚੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dar dar pache manamukh vechaare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The wretched self-willed manmukhs are ruined through fear and dread. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: sir oopar maat pitaa guradev ||
lines.translation: The Divine Guru, my mother and father, is over my head.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: saphal moorat jaa kee niramal sev ||
lines.translation: His image brings prosperity; serving Him, we become pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek nira(n)jan jaa kee raas ||
lines.translation: The One Lord, the Immaculate Lord, is our capital.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mil saadhasa(n)gat hovat paragaas ||1||
lines.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, we are illumined and enlightened. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਠਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeean kaa daataa pooran sabh thaai ||
lines.translation: The Giver of all beings is totally pervading everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot kales mitahi har naai ||
lines.translation: Millions of pains are removed by the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran sagalaa dukh naasai ||
lines.translation: All the pains of birth and death are taken away

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਾਸੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jaa kai man tan baasai ||2||
lines.translation: from the Gurmukh, within whose mind and body the Lord dwells. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no aap lae laR laai ||
lines.translation: He alone, whom the Lord has attached to the hem of His robe,

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: daragah milai tisai hee jaai ||
lines.translation: obtains a place in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਭਗਤ ਜਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: seee bhagat j saache bhaane ||
lines.translation: They alone are devotees, who are pleasing to the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਕਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jamakaal te bhae nikaane ||3||
lines.translation: They are freed from the Messenger of Death. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib sach darabaar ||
lines.translation: True is the Lord, and True is His Court.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: keemat kaun kahai beechaar ||
lines.translation: Who can contemplate and describe His value?

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਗਲ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar sagal adhaar ||
lines.translation: He is within each and every heart, the Support of all.

lines.transliteration: naanak jaachai sa(n)t renaar ||4||3||24||
lines.translation: Nanak begs for the dust of the Saints. ||4||3||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਤੂ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar baahar teraa bharavaasaa too jan kai hai sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: At home, and outside, I place my trust in You; You are always with Your humble servant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa preetam prabh apune naam japau har ra(n)g ||1||
lines.translation: Bestow Your Mercy, O my Beloved God, that I may chant the Lord's Name with love. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan kau prabh apane kaa taan ||
lines.translation: God is the strength of His humble servants.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਾ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo too karahi karaavahi suaamee saa masalat paravaan || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whatever You do, or cause to be done, O Lord and Master, that outcome is acceptable to me. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਗਤਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਖੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pat paramesar gat naaraain dhan gupaal gun saakhee ||
lines.translation: The Transcendent Lord is my honor; the Lord is my emancipation; the glorious sermon of the Lord is my wealth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੀ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: charan saran naanak daas har har sa(n)tee ih bidh jaatee ||2||1||25||
lines.translation: Slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's feet; from the Saints, he has learned this way of life. ||2||1||25||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath prabh te paae ka(n)th laai gur raakhe ||
lines.translation: God has fulfilled all my desires. Holding me close in His embrace, the Guru has saved me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਜਲਨਿ ਨ ਦੀਨੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਭਾਖੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)saar saagar mahi jalan na deene kinai na dutar bhaakhe ||1||
lines.translation: He has saved me from burning in the ocean of fire, and now, no one calls it impassible. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kai man saachaa bisvaas ||
lines.translation: Those who have true faith in their minds,

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਆਨਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਉਲਾਸੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pekh pekh suaamee kee sobhaa aanad sadaa ulaas || rahaau ||
lines.translation: continually behold the Glory of the Lord; they are forever happy and blissful. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਾਖਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan saran pooran paramesur a(n)tarajaamee saakhio ||
lines.translation: I seek the Sanctuary of the feet of the Perfect Transcendent Lord, the Searcher of hearts; I behold Him ever-present.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਨਿ ਬੂਝਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਕੁਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਓ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: jaan boojh apanaa keeo naanak bhagatan kaa a(n)kur raakhio ||2||2||26||
lines.translation: In His wisdom, the Lord has made Nanak His own; He has preserved the roots of His devotees. ||2||2||26||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah jah pekhau tah hajoor door katahu na jaaee ||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, there I see Him present; He is never far away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: rav rahiaa sarabatr mai man sadaa dhiaaee ||1||
lines.translation: He is all-pervading, everywhere; O my mind, meditate on Him forever. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਨਹੀ ਬੀਛੁੜੈ ਸੋ ਸੰਗੀ ਗਨੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: eet oot nahee beechhuRai so sa(n)gee ganeeai ||
lines.translation: He alone is called your companion, who will not be separated from you, here or hereafter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਜੋ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਹਿ ਸੋ ਅਲਪ ਸੁਖੁ ਭਨੀਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: binas jaai jo nimakh mahi so alap sukh bhaneeai || rahaau ||
lines.translation: That pleasure, which passes away in an instant, is trivial. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਅਪਿਆਉ ਦੇਇ ਕਛੁ ਊਨ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: pratipaalai apiaau dei kachh oon na hoee ||
lines.translation: He cherishes us, and gives us sustenance; He does not lack anything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸੰਮਾਲਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: saas saas sa(n)maalataa meraa prabh soee ||2||
lines.translation: With each and every breath, my God takes care of His creatures. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਊਚਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: achhal achhed apaar prabh oochaa jaa kaa roop ||
lines.translation: God is undeceiveable, impenetrable and infinite; His form is lofty and exalted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਜਨ ਅਚਰਜ ਆਨੂਪੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jap jap karahi ana(n)d jan acharaj aanoop ||3||
lines.translation: Chanting and meditating on the embodiment of wonder and beauty, His humble servants are in bliss. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa mat dehu daiaal prabh jit tumahi araadhaa ||
lines.translation: Bless me with such understanding, O Merciful Lord God, that I might remember You.
